about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/lower: edits of the package's source that some test, law or example must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants lower; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it and how to add a mutant. Seeded from the test-speed plan (wf10, 2026-11-08) and the units' verify mutants.
